en: The image shows an old, sepia-toned street scene of a European town. A church with a tall steeple and a clock is centrally featured. Surrounding the church, historical buildings line a cobbled street. Several signs with German text are visible, including 'APOTHEKE' (pharmacy) and 'Schuhmachermeister' (master shoemaker). In the foreground is a small fenced garden with an obelisk-like monument. The words 'Elsterwerda.' and 'Hauptstrasse.' are printed on the postcard.
